Assets API Overview — Xero Developer: Xero docs identify Assets fixed-asset functionality, base URL https://api.xero.com/assets.xro/1.0/, version 1.0 and JSON-only operations: GET/POST Assets and AssetTypes, GET Settings; API applications require OAuth authorization/scopes.

Assets API Assets — Xero Developer: Official Assets resource page documents GET/POST, requires status for collection GET, supports paging and caps pageSize at 200. Overview identifies Settings as GET; current documented API version remains 1.0.

Assets API Release Notes: Only Assets-specific release entry located is v1.0 dated 2016-07-26. This establishes historical launch, not current maintenance; no later Assets-specific release record was found in reviewed official docs.
Scopes — Xero Developer: Official scopes page lists assets.read (“View your fixed assets”) and assets (“View and manage your fixed assets”); scope consent is shown to the user.

OAuth 2.0 — Xero Developer: Xero documents OAuth 2.0 authorization-code/PKCE user-consent flows and machine-to-machine Custom Connections using client credentials. Standard code/PKCE Starter tier is free; Custom Connections have separate per-organization fees by region.

Xero Developer Pricing and Policies: Developer partner page lists Starter no charge (5 connections), Core AUD 35/month, Plus AUD 245/month, Advanced AUD 1,445/month, Enterprise price on application. It lists 1,000 daily API calls/org for Starter and 5,000 for higher tiers. These are developer app-partner fees/limits, not end-customer Xero Accounting subscription pricing.

Development Accounts — Xero Developer: Xero says developer sign-up is free; testing can use a dummy-data demo company that resets after 28 days or a trial/paid Xero organization. A trial organization is limited to 30 days before billing information is required; this does not imply a free live customer subscription.

OAuth 2.0 API Limits — Xero Developer: Explicit OAuth limits: 5 concurrent, 60 calls/minute and 1,000 calls/day per tenant at Starter; 5,000/day higher tiers; app-wide 10,000 calls/minute. Daily limits use fixed windows with reset times varying by tenant.

Rate Limits — Xero Developer: General page repeats tiered figures in its main section, but a generic X-DayLimit-Remaining header gloss says 5,000/day per tenant without Starter exception. This inconsistency is retained; OAuth limits and pricing pages agree on tiered 1,000/5,000 figures.

SDKs — Xero Developer: Xero SDK index lists xero-python, whose linked docs are Accounting-focused; reviewed sources do not establish Assets-specific SDK coverage. Assets REST/JSON plus OAuth docs nevertheless support feasible custom Python HTTP integration. No code executed.

Assets API Settings — Xero Developer: Official docs publish GET https://api.xero.com/assets.xro/1.0/Settings. Assets resource docs also describe GET/POST Assets, collection status, paging and max pageSize 200. Documentation only; no Xero endpoint was contacted.

Xero Developer Platform Terms & Conditions: Terms page is marked last updated 2025-12-04. Terms restrict API Data use to approved app purpose, require user consent/permissions, prohibit AI model training/fine-tuning/adaptation and restrict third-party passthrough without consent; aggregation/supply to another app and resale/sublicensing of platform access are also restricted. No open data license is granted.
